items.name: Big 'n Blind 2017

venue.name: Guangzhou Nanwu Middle School
venue.address: No. 81 Xingyuan Street, Jiangnanxi Road, Haizhu District

items.information:
It's the 2nd Big 'n Blind Open here, which is only for big cubes and blindfold events. 
The limitation is 150 participants, based on a first-come-first-serve rule.
For Chinese domestic participants, a completed registration is online registration plus prepaid registration fee. For oversea participants, if you can't pay the fee online, pls contact the delegate. Then we will make a reservation for you and you can pay the fee by cash on-the-site. Please check the competition website for registration and the other information.

items.name: Malabar Winter Cube Open 2017
items.information:
**Online registration fee**
Pass fee (for participating): 200
Each event: 50
So if you are participating in 3 events, fees will be 200 + (3x50) = 350.
Registration closes: 7 Dec, '17, 11:59 p.m. IST

**Spot registration fee**
Pass fee (for participating): 350
Each event: 50
So if you are participating in 3 events, fees will be 350 + (3x50) = 500.
Registration starts: 10 Dec, '17, 8 a.m. IST
Registration closes: 10 Dec, '17, 10 a.m. IST

items.name: Davao Year End Open 2017

venue.name: Philippine Nikkie Jin Kai International School
venue.address: Mamay Rd, Lanang, Davao City, 8000 Davao del Sur

items.information:
Let's enjoy and have fun as we end this year with a blast. Davao Year End Open 2017 will be the last Official WCA competition here in Davao region. Big prizes and giveaways will be given to you!

Registration fee is P300 for the first 3 events and additional P50 for each additional category.

Each competitor will recieve a competitor's kit that contains the following.

1. Certificate
2. Competition ID
3. Competition Id lace
4. Copy of the groupings
5. Copy of the schedule

Prizes are sponsored by Puzzle Maxx Mindanao. This competition will be organize by the Philippine Cubers Association organizing committee

**Payment first before we will accept your registration 
Join now!**

items.name: Cubing with the Viking 2017

venue.name: Ellison Campus Center, Salem State University
venue.details: The competition is in Veterans Hall, which is on the second floor of the Ellison Campus Center.

items.information: There is a 110 competitor limit for this competition.  The Ellison Campus Center is #10 on the map which can be found [here](https://newsite.salemstate.edu/sites/default/files/pdfs/SSU_MAP_08_16_Parking.pdf).  Money raised from this competition will be going toward the SSU Community Service Group in order to assist those affected by Hurricane Harvey in Texas.
